applies_why: The judge text does not do the thing K-S2 governs: it rests on the defender's dropped limb, not on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that admits both readings is such a verse. It is not, if the judge names another verse or phrase that settles it.
why: Because the judge does not use the absence of a single verse's statement as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED, K-S2 is not breached.
